name: AI import
description: Bring your history from ChatGPT and Claude: their official exports become a note per chat (and per Claude project), and what they remembered about you a list you review before any of it reaches ME.md or People.

folder.label: Folder
folder.description: where chats go, a subfolder per AI (Chats/ChatGPT, Chats/Claude)

minMessages.label: Fewest messages
minMessages.description: chats with fewer messages are left out; 0 imports every one

images.label: Import images
images.description: ChatGPT's images go into the chats' Attachments folder (Claude's exports have none)

memory-review.description: a memory review list's count and its Add button: the ticked memories go into ME.md or People
